label: Vacuum or robot vacuum

questions.text: What kind of vacuum is it?
questions.why: Corded, cordless and robot vacuums need different care.

questions.text: How many times a week is it used?
questions.why: Heavy use fills filters and wears brushes faster.

questions.text: How often are the bin and filter emptied and cleaned?
questions.why: A full bin or dirty filter strains the motor.

questions.text: Is it ever used to pick up water or wet dirt?
questions.why: Only wet-and-dry models can take liquid.

answers.label: Yes, it is a wet-and-dry model
Yes, but it is not a wet-and-dry model

questions.text: Are hair and threads cleared from the brush?
Have you noticed weak suction, a burning smell or the battery not charging?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: If the battery swells, gets very hot or smells unusual, stop using the vacuum and keep it away from anything that can burn.
care_tips.why: A damaged battery can catch fire.

care_tips.text: Switch off and unplug the vacuum (or switch it off and remove it from the dock) before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning an appliance that is plugged in risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the vacuum or its battery yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Don't pick up water or wet dirt unless it is a wet-and-dry model.
care_tips.why: Liquid can damage the motor and cause a shock.

care_tips.text: Empty the bin and clean the filter as the manual describes.
care_tips.why: A full bin or dirty filter strains the motor.

care_tips.text: Clear hair and threads from the brush (switched off).
Charge it only with its own charger or dock.
care_tips.why: The wrong charger can damage the battery.

care_tips.text: If suction gets weak after cleaning the filter, or it smells of burning, contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: These can be signs of a motor fault.

reminders.text: Clean the vacuum's filter and brush (switched off).
reminders.interval_text: about every 2 weeks with regular use
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.
